subject.title: fix(macos): refresh skills after local node reconnect

question: Which of the two overlapping macOS reconnect-refresh PRs should be the canonical implementation after native proof is supplied?
rationale: Both branches address the same reproduced state bug and neither has sufficient real macOS after-fix evidence; selecting notification/testability conventions is a maintainer ownership choice rather than a safe automated repair.

options.title: Adopt the earlier candidate after proof
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107660 as the canonical branch if it supplies native proof, preserving its explicit refresh-drain loop and injectable notification center.

options.title: Adopt this candidate after proof
options.body: Retain this branch if maintainers prefer its notification naming and can validate the same full reconnect flow in a native macOS app.

options.title: Consolidate before merge
options.body: Ask for one narrow canonical PR that combines the selected conventions and includes native after-fix evidence.

recommendation.title: Adopt the earlier candidate after proof
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107660 as the canonical branch if it supplies native proof, preserving its explicit refresh-drain loop and injectable notification center.

likelyOwner.reason: Available feature-history evidence points to this person as the closest adjacent owner for the macOS UI and local-node routing boundary.
